consumer: game::npc_menu's amenu.query() at the bumped-into friendly NPC tile, asking the player which interaction (Talk / Swap positions / Push away / examine / steal / attack) to perform.
scope: the single interactive menu query for this NPC interaction answered through the real active input loop; not carried items, not a map region.
decisive_source: src/game.cpp::game::npc_menu builds a uilist of NPC interaction options and calls amenu.query(), an interactive menu that must be answered through the real input mechanism rather than defaulted.
divergence: Avatar bumps a friendly NPC and the backend silently swaps positions (or no-ops) without presenting/answering the menu, producing a world state that differs from what choosing Talk would have produced (dialogue opened vs. positions swapped).
